messages.Im Tab Datenbanken eine Datenbank anlege: Create a database in the Databases tab and add fields. Types include values, text, numbers, booleans, identifiers, images, files and JSON. Records can be edited and deleted.

messages.DeepFace akzeptiert weiterhin zwei Bilde: DeepFace accepts two images, or a reference image and a database. Select an image column; matching records appear as groups with provenance and comparison values. Review comparison limits and warnings.
messages.Glances zeigen Bilder, Videos und Karten: Glances show images, videos and maps on the canvas. Quick actions open the resource in a new tab. Video cropping uses a shared time-range control and a graphical crop area.
messages.Im Location-Node Adresse oder Koordinate: Enter an address or coordinates in a location node and enable the map preview. The preview loads through ARGUS and follows its network settings.

messages.In der Toolbar Report öffnen, Berichtsan: Open Report from the toolbar, add notes and refresh the preview. Print / save as PDF creates a report on white A4 paper. Nested data uses field paths without increasing indentation.

messages.Projekt-Logs zeigen Ausführungen; System: Project logs show tool runs; system logs offer search, export and automatic refresh. For incomplete results, inspect warnings and provenance first. Store credentials in plugin settings.

messages.ui.add_a_database_node_and_choose_a_data: Add a database node and choose a database. Connect Search database to that node and a value, email, phone, URL or username node. Choose the reference column on the first execution. Each matching record becomes a separate group containing all populated fields.
messages.ui.deepface_accepts_two_images_or_a_refe: DeepFace accepts two images, or a reference image and a database. Select an image column; matching records appear as groups with provenance and comparison values. Review comparison limits and warnings.
messages.ui.glances_show_images_videos_and_maps_o: Glances show images, videos and maps on the canvas. Quick actions open the resource in a new tab. Video cropping uses a shared time-range control and a graphical crop area.
messages.ui.enter_an_address_or_coordinates_in_a_: Enter an address or coordinates in a location node and enable the map preview. The preview loads through ARGUS and follows its network settings.
messages.ui.verification_and_custom_tags_help_ass: Verification and custom tags help assess findings. Include in report controls which nodes appear in the report. Verify results independently.
messages.ui.open_report_from_the_toolbar_add_note: Open Report from the toolbar, add notes and refresh the preview. Print / save as PDF creates a report on white A4 paper. Nested data uses field paths without increasing indentation.
messages.ui.plugin_settings_separate_global_confi: Plugin settings separate global configuration from defaults for new tool runs. Configure sources and their order there; search profiles can be changed for a specific search.
messages.ui.manage_openvpn_or_wireguard_profiles_: Manage OpenVPN or WireGuard profiles in settings. Rotate on a timer or after a tool run. When VPN use is enabled, the queue waits for the connection. The Docker host must provide the documented networking permissions.
messages.ui.project_logs_show_tool_runs_system_lo: Project logs show tool runs; system logs offer search, export and automatic refresh. For incomplete results, inspect warnings and provenance first. Store credentials in plugin settings.
